Class ChromaticGroovyPlugin.Text

java.lang.Object
com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.registry.NamedRegistry
com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.registry.VirtualizedRegistry<ChromaticGroovyPlugin.Declaration>

All Implemented Interfaces:
com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.api.INamed, com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.api.IScriptReloadable
Enclosing class:
ChromaticGroovyPlugin
public static final class ChromaticGroovyPlugin.Text extends com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.registry.VirtualizedRegistry<ChromaticGroovyPlugin.Declaration>
Stages one script contribution and publishes it after the script loader finishes.

A rejected operation or final validation failure leaves the previous owned contribution active. Reload starts a new empty draft; an empty successful load removes this registry's prior definitions. Cleanup uses exact binding identity, preserving a later replacement by another owner. Replacing a trigger does not restore any older entry it displaced. Failures outside this facade are governed by GroovyScript, not silently treated as a failed text operation. Use from GroovyScript's serialized reloadable loader, not concurrent background callbacks.

    • register

      public ChromaticGroovyPlugin.Text register(ChromaticDefinitions.Kind kind, String id, Object trigger, Integer color, IChromaticEffect effect)
      Stages any supported color, effect or outline declaration through the complete Java registry contract.
      Parameters:
      kind - declaration category
      id - caller-chosen namespaced identity
      trigger - character or bracketed name as required by kind; null for a direct effect
      color - packed RGB only for color kinds, otherwise null
      effect - callback only for effect kinds, otherwise null; retained by reference
      Returns:
      this registry for successive declarations
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the declaration is invalid; the whole pending contribution is rejected

      public IChromaticEffect effect(String movement, List<Integer> palette, float colorSpeed, float moveSpeed, float playbackSpeed, Map<String,?> options)
      Creates a built-in or registered custom effect with the same options and timing validator as Java/Kotlin.
      Parameters:
      movement - movement ID or semicolon-option descriptor
      palette - nonempty packed RGB colors
      colorSpeed - finite effect-specific color control
      moveSpeed - finite effect-specific movement/geometry control
      playbackSpeed - independent finite time multiplier between -32 and 32
      options - explicit options, taking precedence over descriptor options
      Returns:
      newly configured effect; creation alone does not publish a code
